name: Rajeev Chempath
player_statement:
A complete player, Rajeev Chempath has made a big mark in cricket. With 122 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 75, with an average of 17.03 and a quick strike rate of 94.34. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 22 sixes and 148 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 353.1 overs, taking 93 wickets at an economy rate of 6.93. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
